he_version: Midrash Tanhuma haKadum veHaYashan, S. Buber, 1885
en_version: Midrash Tanhuma, S. Buber Recension; trans. by John T. Townsend, 1989.
en: (Gen. 1:1) "God created in the beginning" (with this word order).81This wording, which puts “God” first in the sentence, does not agree with the Septuagint, which follows the Masoretic Text.
